appearanceLayer.note: Original appearance baseline: 610 rules / 131,726 bytes. Current standalone stylesheet 235 contains 729 parsed rules / 157,551 bytes, including viewport-bounded security settings and the hidden localStorage-only backup status card; all non-dashboard calendar overlays retain the shared bottom-sheet style and fiscal-period range behavior.

currentState.note: Current stylesheet state on disk; 10 linked stylesheets and 3,453 parsed rules. Non-dashboard calendars use the shared bottom-sheet design; the security settings dialog is bounded to the visible viewport, and the backup storage status card is hidden. Historical cascade-equivalence proof remains unchanged.

onboardingCompact.note: Intentional compact first-run UI; historical cascade-equality proof unchanged.

transactionFilter.note: Compact date inputs and explicit attachment checkbox state.

onboardingSimplification.note: Remove redundant first-run headers and contain input widths.

transactionAmountColors.note: Explicit vivid and contrast-tested income/expense amount colors.

globalPlaceholderHints.note: All input and textarea placeholder hints use a fixed 12px size; entered values unchanged.

trendDetail.note: کارت جزئیات نمودار روند روزانه با حذف کامل ویجت از برنامه برداشته شد؛ هر ۸ قاعدهٔ قبلی هم از لایهٔ ۲۳۵ پاک شدند.

advancedFilterTypography.note: Advanced transaction filter drops the unused event row and keeps its fields at 12px; ordinary writable text inputs and textareas are normalized to 14px, while explicit compact text-* classes and scoped filter sizes remain intact.

paymentRouteAlignment.note: دو کادر «پرداخت به / دریافت از» و «از حساب / به حساب» در فرم ثبت سند ستون برچسب هم‌عرض (۴٫۲۵rem) می‌گیرند تا لبه‌های کادرها موازی بمانند — هم در حالت عادی و هم در حالت خطای درون‌کادری.

formTransitions.note: Horizontal form entry, successful confirmation, and Back transitions with reduced-motion support.

onboardingTransitions.note: First-run onboarding step changes use a brief opacity-only fade, without horizontal movement; reduced-motion is respected.

motionSystem.note: Cohesive lightweight motion timings, immediate full-page navigation, reduced-motion coverage, incremental overlay annotations, reduced expensive blur, and lightweight exit visuals.

datePickerGlassScrim.note: All calendars except the independent dashboard date-info calendar share the designed bottom-sheet appearance. Single-date and returned-check calendars use the keypad-matched dim scrim without blur; fiscal and transaction range pickers retain from/to behavior while adopting the same bottom-sheet and scrim styling.

themeTypographyConsistency.note: Remove light-theme-only font-size inflation for compact labels and transaction amounts so class-defined sizes remain identical in light and dark modes.

securitySettingsViewport.note: Viewport-bounded security settings dialog leaves visible space around the card and shrinks safely while the Android keyboard is open.

storageStatusCardSuppression.note: Hide the localStorage-only status widget in the backup UI; the storage and backup/restore implementation remains unchanged.
